Questions

Before You Get Started

Is this legal or licensing advice?
No. CareStart Pro is a business planning and reference toolkit, not legal, tax, or licensing advice. Always confirm current requirements with your state's official licensing agency before you file anything.
Do I need caregiving or business experience?
No. The roadmap is built to walk a first-time founder through every phase, whether you're a caregiver going independent or an entrepreneur entering the industry for the first time.
What if my state isn't covered?
All 50 states plus DC are included in the Compliance Guide, so wherever you're launching, it's covered.
Is this a subscription?
No. It's a single $275 payment (or 4 payments of $73.75) for lifetime access to all six components — no recurring charges.
What format are the files in?
PDF and fillable PDF forms, delivered as an instant digital download right after checkout.
